_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: Top-N-per-branch attribution RECORD pass over datacenter. Each config enables --branch_load_dep_attribute_record 1 and caps the marked delaying loads to N per dynamic mispredicted-branch instance via --branch_load_dep_attr_max_loads N, keeping the N most-important loads ranked by --branch_load_dep_attr_rank (0 = total stall cycles, 1 = criticality tier). Every config writes its own per-simpoint <bench>_<simpt>_braddr.csv (line,cycles), branch_delay_loads.csv (with capped_cycles), _pf.csv (seqnum,line) and the new _brstream.csv (branch_pc -> kept load lines) into a DISTINCT --branch_load_dep_trace_dir, so the paired replay (bld_topn_marked_hit_datacenter) can force-hit exactly that config's kept line set. N=0 (rec_all) records the full delaying-load set = the mechanism ceiling. REQUIRES scarab_path built from the bld-attr-topn-loads-per-branch branch (adds attr_max_loads/attr_rank and the brstream CSV). Keep top_simpoint identical to the replay descriptor so the recorded simpoints line up.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the bld-attr-topn-loads-per-branch branch (adds --branch_load_dep_attr_max_loads / --branch_load_dep_attr_rank and the _brstream.csv emit).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'. MUST match bld_topn_marked_hit_datacenter so the recorded per-simpoint CSVs cover the simpoints the replay reads back.
_simulations: Attribution-record pass over the datacenter suite. Each workload/simpoint writes its own <bench>_<simpt>_{braddr,pf,brstream}.csv into that config's --branch_load_dep_trace_dir.
_configurations: One record config per (N, rank). Each writes to a DISTINCT trace dir (br_braddr_path derives <dir>/<bench>_<simpt>_braddr.csv), so the replay descriptor points each marked_hit config at the matching dir. rec_all (N=0) records every delaying load = the full mechanism ceiling and is rank-independent. _cyc = rank 0 (total stall cycles), _crit = rank 1 (criticality tier).

rec_n1_cyc._params: N=1 per branch, ranked by stall cycles -> topn_n1_cyc.

rec_n2_cyc._params: N=2 per branch, ranked by stall cycles -> topn_n2_cyc.

rec_n3_cyc._params: N=3 per branch, ranked by stall cycles -> topn_n3_cyc.

rec_n1_crit._params: N=1 per branch, ranked by criticality tier -> topn_n1_crit.

rec_n2_crit._params: N=2 per branch, ranked by criticality tier -> topn_n2_crit.

rec_n3_crit._params: N=3 per branch, ranked by criticality tier -> topn_n3_crit.

rec_all._params: N=0 (unlimited) = every delaying load, rank-independent -> topn_all. The full mechanism ceiling the capped sets are measured against.

_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
